author: Ted (@haot3x)
payment: Buyer funds units times the market's immutable unitPrice in its configured exact-transfer test token.
cancellation: Full refund before the admission window starts; a direct ledger release remains recoverable through claimRefund.
unusedExpiry: A confirmed booking unused at windowEnd receives a full refund, including after third-party cleanup.
acceptance: The buyer is the sole evaluator. After provider submission, buyer acceptance before settlementDeadline pays the provider; rejection refunds the buyer.
timeout: Any admitted or submitted order that remains unpaid at settlementDeadline is refundable to the original buyer by any caller.
capacity: Consumed admission quota is never restored by completion, rejection, or refund.
restrictions: No partial consumption, resale, cancellation fees, amendments, cross-chain settlement, arbitration, or automatic off-chain execution.
commitment: termsHash is keccak256 of the exact UTF-8 bytes of this file, including its final newline.
